description: A long plume shading violet to gold, softer than anything else on the stall, and off nothing anyone has seen.
lore: It is useless. Too soft to write with, too soft to fletch, too limp to trim a hat that would hold its shape in any wind. It has one use and it is on no list. You put it into the hand of somebody who has just woken and cannot stop shaking, because a hand holding something shakes less, and because it is the first pleasant thing this country has given them. [[characters/cfe826c1|Jehanne]] carries three, buys more than she needs, and does not call it a rite.
gm_notes: Jehanne's practice-without-belief shrunk to one object. Any NPC who meets wakings can be carrying one; the plume is the tell that they do it often.
